_comment: Featured repos, in README order. Star/fork/language come live from the API on every run; the description here overrides the repo's own GitHub description. Setting them on GitHub too is worth doing - it helps anyone browsing your repo list.

projects.description: Hosting-admin tool that fixes broken file ownership and permissions on cPanel accounts, so sites stop throwing 500/403 errors after migrations and restores.
Production-ready SaaS-style task manager with JWT auth, role-based access control, and project/task tracking. React, Node, Express, MongoDB.
Personal developer portfolio built with React + TypeScript, animated with Framer Motion and styled with Tailwind CSS.
Event-driven WhatsApp notifications for WordPress/WooCommerce - order and user event hooks, admin config panel, and error handling.
